method: Same Chrome desktop app Dashboard, sync click until Sync button enabled, one excluded warmup and seven samples each. Client wall-clock including browser automation overhead. No financial data writes between sets; all synthetic fixtures created afterwards.
limitations: Sequential samples, not interleaved/randomized; network/cache/automation overhead may contribute. No server-side VC timing or Performance Analyzer measurement captured. No extrapolation to production.

statisticsBeforeAndAfter.observation: Same visible dashboard counts before synthetic fixtures; zero-count groups not displayed.
